name: application-file-uploaders
title: File Uploaders
description: File uploader components with drag-and-drop, previews, and progress indicators for web applications.
useWhen: File uploader components with drag-and-drop, previews, and progress indicators for web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid file uploaders when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: File Uploaders uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
